rationale: Problem: a new adopter board could not merge (interim never), failing the 2026-11-19 'configured and running' requirement; onGreenClean by default loosens the adopter default. No comparable tool (Renovate, Dependabot, GitHub auto-merge, Mergify) merges by default. Counter: the gate already makes merging safe and a question is friction. Survives: the gate makes merging safe but not consented; one question costs seconds and a yes gives the same end state. Operator chose 2026-11-22.
